# Normalize 

```{r}
pcs_lslsv <- list()
for (i in 1:length(all_lslsobj)) {
  
  ### Get tissue name and object list
  currTissue_v <- names(all_lslsobj)[i]
  currTissue_lsobj <- all_lslsobj[[currTissue_v]]
  currTissuePcs_lsv <- list()
  
  ### Run first half of normalization procedure on each major population
  for (j in 1:length(currTissue_lsobj)) {
    
    ### Get major population object
    currPop_v <- names(currTissue_lsobj)[j]
    currPop_obj <- currTissue_lsobj[[currPop_v]]
    
    ### Normalize
    currPop_obj <- NormalizeData(currPop_obj, verbose = F) 
    currPop_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(currPop_obj)
    currPop_obj <- ScaleData(currPop_obj)
    currPop_obj <- RunPCA(currPop_obj)
    currPopPcs_v <- findPCs(currPop_obj, ndims_v = 50, min_v = minPC_v)
    
    ### Update/add
    currTissue_lsobj[[currPop_v]] <- currPop_obj
    currTissuePcs_lsv[[currPop_v]] <- currPopPcs_v
    
    invisible(gc())
    
  } # for j
  
  ### Update/add
  all_lslsobj[[currTissue_v]] <- currTissue_lsobj
  pcs_lslsv[[currTissue_v]] <- currTissuePcs_lsv
  
} # for i
```

# Cluster QC

```{r}
clusterQCDir_v <- mkdir(qcDir_v, "subClusterQCSweep_minPC")

for (i in 1:length(all_lslsobj)) {
  
  ### Get tissue name and object list
  currTissue_v <- names(all_lslsobj)[i]
  currTissue_lsobj <- all_lslsobj[[currTissue_v]]
  currTissuePcs_lsv <- pcs_lslsv[[currTissue_v]]
  currBaseDir_v <- mkdir(clusterQCDir_v, currTissue_v)
  
  ### Run cluster QC
  for (j in 1:length(currTissue_lsobj)) {
    
    ### Get major population object
    currPop_v <- names(currTissue_lsobj)[j]
    currPop_obj <- currTissue_lsobj[[currPop_v]]
    currPcs_v <- currTissuePcs_lsv[[currPop_v]]
    currOutDir_v <- mkdir(currBaseDir_v, currPop_v)
    
    ### Cluster Sweep
    myClusterSweep(seurat_obj = currPop_obj, ndims_v = currPcs_v, name_v = currPop_v,
                   indPlots_v = T, plotDir_v = currOutDir_v)
    invisible(gc())
    
  } # for j

} # for i
```

```{r}
 ### Remove any clustering columns that are already in the object, to make sure that they don't interfere with QC run
  cols_v <- grep("_res", colnames(seurat_obj@meta.data), value = T)
  if (length(cols_v) > 0) {
    for (col_v in cols_v) seurat_obj@meta.data[[col_v]] <- NULL
  }
  
  ###
  ### CALCULATIONS ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  ###
  
  origNames_v <- names(seurat_obj)
  origCols_v <- colnames(seurat_obj@meta.data)
  
  ### Find neighbors using specified number of dimensions
  seurat_obj <- Seurat::FindNeighbors(seurat_obj, reduction = reduction_v, dims = 1:ndims_v, verbose = verbose_v)
  
  newNames1_v <- names(seurat_obj)
  newCols1_v <- colnames(seurat_obj@meta.data)
  
  ### Find clusters using the specified resolutions
  seurat_obj <- Seurat::FindClusters(seurat_obj, resolution = res_v, verbose = verbose_v)
  
  newNames2_v <- names(seurat_obj)
  newCols2_v <- colnames(seurat_obj@meta.data)
  
  ### Calculate UMAP
  if (!reductionName_v %in% names(seurat_obj)) {
    seurat_obj <- Seurat::RunUMAP(seurat_obj, dims = 1:ndims_v, reduction = reduction_v, reduction.name = reductionName_v, verbose = F)
  }
```

# Cluster

```{r}
for (i in 1:length(all_lslsobj)) {
  
  ### Get tissue name and object list
  currTissue_v <- names(all_lslsobj)[i]
  currTissue_lsobj <- all_lslsobj[[currTissue_v]]
  currTissuePcs_lsv <- pcs_lslsv[[currTissue_v]]
  currTissueRes_lsv <- res_lslsv[[currTissue_v]]
  
  ### Run first half of normalization procedure on each major population
  for (j in 1:length(currTissue_lsobj)) {
    
    ### Get major population object
    currPop_v <- names(currTissue_lsobj)[j]
    currPop_obj <- currTissue_lsobj[[currPop_v]]
    currPopPcs_v <- currTissuePcs_lsv[[currPop_v]]
    currPopRes_v <- currTissueRes_lsv[[currPop_v]]
    
    ### Cluster
    currPop_obj <- FindNeighbors(currPop_obj, dims = 1:currPopPcs_v, verbose = F)
    currPop_obj <- FindClusters(currPop_obj, resolution = currPopRes_v, verbose = F)
    currPop_obj <- RunUMAP(currPop_obj, dims = 1:currPopPcs_v, verbose = F, return.model = T)
    
    ### Update
    currTissue_lsobj[[currPop_v]] <- currPop_obj
    
  } # for j
  
  ### Update
  all_lslsobj[[currTissue_v]] <- currTissue_lsobj
  
} # for i
```

# UMAP

```{r}
umapDir_v <- mkdir(plotDir_v, "subClusterUMAP_minPC")

for (i in 1:length(all_lslsobj)) {
  
  ### Get tissue name and object list
  currTissue_v <- names(all_lslsobj)[i]
  currTissue_lsobj <- all_lslsobj[[currTissue_v]]
  currUMAPOutDir_v <- mkdir(umapDir_v, currTissue_v)
  
  ### UMAP per major pop
  for (j in 1:length(currTissue_lsobj)) {
    
    ### Get major population object
    currPop_v <- names(currTissue_lsobj)[j]
    currPop_obj <- currTissue_lsobj[[currPop_v]]
    
    ### Make Plot
    currDim_gg <- DimPlot(currPop_obj, group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = T) +
      coord_equal() +
      ggtitle(paste0(currTissue_v, " - ", currPop_v))
    
    ### Print Plot
    print(currDim_gg)
    
    ### Save Plot
    pdf(file = file.path(currUMAPOutDir_v, paste0(currPop_v, "_dimPlot.pdf")))
    print(currDim_gg)
    dev.off()
    
  } # for j
  
} # for i
```

# Dotplot

Unsorted first

```{r, fig.height=20, fig.width=8}
dotDir_v <- mkdir(plotDir_v, "subClusterDot")
# dotList_lsv <- list("lymphoid" = lymphoidMinorPopGenes_v,
#                     "myeloid" = myeloidMinorPopGenes_v,
#                     "other" = dotMarkers_v)

dotList_lsv <- list("lymphoid" = allDotMarkers_lsv,
                    "myeloid" = myeloidMarkers_lsv,
                    "other" = list("other" = dotMarkers_v))

dotHeight_lsv <- list("lymphoid" = list("Tmajor" = 30, "Tsub" = 28, "Bsub" = 10),
                      "myeloid" = list("subAll" = 50, "subMacs" = 30, "subDCs" = 10, "subNeuMDSCs" = 14),
                      "other" = list("other" = 20))

for (i in 1:length(all_lslsobj)) {
  
  ### Get tissue name and object list
  currTissue_v <- names(all_lslsobj)[i]
  currTissue_lsobj <- all_lslsobj[[currTissue_v]]
  currOutDir_v <- mkdir(dotDir_v, currTissue_v)
  
  ### Dot per major pop
  for (j in 1:length(currTissue_lsobj)) {
    
    ### Get major population object
    currPop_v <- names(currTissue_lsobj)[j]
    currPop_obj <- currTissue_lsobj[[currPop_v]]
    currList_lsv <- dotList_lsv[[currPop_v]]
    currHeight_lsv <- dotHeight_lsv[[currPop_v]]
    
    ### Make Plot
    for (k in 1:length(currList_lsv)) {
      
      currList_v <- currList_lsv[[k]]
      currHeight_v <- currHeight_lsv[[k]]
      
      currDot_gg <- DotPlot(currPop_obj, 
                            group.by = "seurat_clusters",
                            features = unname(currList_v),
                            cols = "RdYlBu") +
        coord_flip() +
        scale_x_discrete(labels = paste(names(currList_v), unname(currList_v), sep = "_")) + 
        ggtitle(paste0(currTissue_v, " - ", currPop_v, " - ", names(currList_lsv)[k], " Markers"))
      
      ### Print Plot
      print(currDot_gg)
      
      ### Save Plot
      pdf(file = file.path(currOutDir_v, paste0(currPop_v, "_", names(currList_lsv)[k], "Markers_dimPlot.pdf")),
          width = 8, height = currHeight_v)
      print(currDot_gg)
      dev.off()
    } # for k
    
  } # for j
  
} # for i
```

# SingleR

```{r load Ref, eval = F}
refFiles_v <- list.files(refDir_v, pattern = "batch")
ref_lsobj <- lapply(refFiles_v, function(x) readRDS(file.path(refDir_v, x)))
names(ref_lsobj) <- gsub("batch12_|batch3_|\\.rds", "", refFiles_v)
ref_lssce <- lapply(ref_lsobj, function(x) as.SingleCellExperiment(x, assay = "RNA"))

```

```{r, eval = T}
for (i in 1:length(all_lslsobj)) {
  
  ### Get tissue name and object list
  currTissue_v <- names(all_lslsobj)[i]
  currTissue_lsobj <- all_lslsobj[[currTissue_v]]
  
  for (j in 1:length(currTissue_lsobj)) {
    
    ### Get major population object
    currPop_v <- names(currTissue_lsobj)[j]
    currPop_obj <- currTissue_lsobj[[currPop_v]]
    
    ### Get reference
    if (currPop_v == "other") currRefName_v <- "neoplastic" else currRefName_v <- currPop_v
    
    ### Get query matrix
    currQuery_mat <- GetAssayData(currPop_obj, layer = "data")
    
    ### Run prediction
    tictoc::tic()
    currPred <- SingleR(test = currQuery_mat, ref = ref_lssce[[currRefName_v]],
                        labels = ref_lssce[[currRefName_v]]$sPop,
                        BPPARAM=MulticoreParam(8))
    tictoc::toc()
    
    ### Add to object
    currPop_obj$SingleR <- currPred$pruned.labels
    currTissue_lsobj[[currPop_v]] <- currPop_obj
    
  } # for j
  
  all_lslsobj[[currTissue_v]] <- currTissue_lsobj
} # for i




# Add pruned labels (low-confidence calls set to NA) to Seurat metadata
pbmc$SingleR_label <- pred$pruned.labels
```
